recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. FHIR-3511 itself is implemented in current build inputs; later, narrower ValueSet expansion tracker items should remain separate decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-3511 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request against FHIR-core ValueSet for DSTU1. It reported that the ValueSet.expansion definition only said "When value set is an expansion" and asked for more detail; the accepted resolution was to improve the definition.
initial_application: The Jira comments record application on 29-Sept-2014 in SVN revision 2925. Git-svn commit 009a24e89282b9ef02ddcb91e8a721cf1733189d, "Clarify definition of ValueSet.expansion (task 3511)", replaced the terse spreadsheet short definition with "Used when the value set is \"expanded\"" and added a definition and comment explaining expansion as an enumerated code collection used for data entry or validation. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that text into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet under active [resources], and ValueSet remains a current normative resource. Later ValueSet expansion changes concern narrower expansion identifier, contains.version, property, and parameter details and do not reverse the base ValueSet.expansion definition. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting community or work-group context.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml ValueSet.expansion element already has the detailed short, definition, and comment requested by FHIR-3511, with compatible later clarifications about stateless expansions and expansion.parameter.
